Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Nikhil - 8 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Sunita - 37 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Riya - 12 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
4. Vimla - 68 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
5. Tanay - 11 years, friend
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Sunita and Vimla stand near him.]

Sunita: "Let's do something fun today."

[Nikhil tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Nikhil (surprised): "Careful!"

[Hailstones start falling.]

Nikhil (softly): "Hmm, I see."

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Sunita: "This is amazing!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Sunita and Riya stand near him.]

Sunita: "What a nice place."

[Nikhil puts on his school uniform.]

Sunita (softly): "That's great!"

[Nikhil combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Nikhil: "I knew it!"

[Nikhil puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Nikhil: "I really enjoyed today."
